dog.description_text:
Muffy is a big, fluffy Great Pyrenees mix puppy who is expected to be a large girl once she’s fully grown. She is so silly, so goofy, and somehow also such a good girl. She loves other dogs, does well with cats, and is happiest when she has a little room to be her ridiculous puppy self.

The city is still a little scary for Muffy, so she’ll need someone who can help her build confidence at her own pace. Like any puppy, she’ll also need a patient adopter who is committed to training, socialization, and helping her grow into the best version of herself. Experience with Great Pyrenees or an understanding of the breed would definitely be a plus.

Registered adopters interested in Muffy can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
